title: Demo Business Automation & Web System
subtitle: Complete reference case study demonstrating custom AI tools, CRM integration, and responsive web infrastructure.
summary: This is a demonstration case study showing how case study data in contents/work/demo-project.json seamlessly links with image assets stored in public/work/demo-project/. Use this as a reference template when adding new client projects.
challenge: The client struggled with manual lead tracking, slow customer response times, and fragmented data across multiple legacy tools.
Without a unified modern web platform, off-hours inquiries were lost and operational overhead continued to scale.
solution: We engineered a custom AI-Powered Business Website built on Next.js and Supabase.
The platform features automated lead scoring, an embedded conversational AI assistant, and real-time CRM webhooks.
results: Increased off-hours lead capture by 45% within the first 30 days.
Saved an estimated 15 operational hours per week per team member.
Achieved 100% automated synchronization between web forms and backend CRM.
